title: ヨルマート午前三時
caption: Mellow jazzy hip hop with a Japanese city pop mood, intimate and late-night. A low, unhurried male voice raps in Japanese, almost speaking, close to the microphone; a soft female voice sings the short hook. Dusty, laid-back boom-bap drums with brushed hi-hats, warm upright bass, mellow Rhodes electric piano chords, a muted trumpet drifting in and out, vinyl crackle. Lonely but warm, a convenience store glowing on an empty street at three in the morning.
